mappings.scope: Lexical string/array splitting, stable lowercase terms and duplicate/empty removal flow into a real workflow.
mappings.remaining: Lexical tokens grant no kind or policy authority; complete typed declaration and grammar obligations require their own profile evidence and review.

mappings.scope: An actual Ed25519 prompt with the seed kid and no trusted key is rejected before inference.
mappings.remaining: Key lifecycle, registry services, retention and revocation are not all exercised by unknown-key rejection.

mappings.scope: Tampered bytes, unavailable authority and stale signed session bindings suppress inference/output.
mappings.remaining: This does not discharge every algorithm, canonicalization, metadata, scope or engine requirement.

mappings.scope: An exclusive expiration boundary rejects the actual signed prompt before provider invocation.
mappings.remaining: Historical retention, clock-skew and key rotation require additional coverage.

mappings.scope: Host and separate proxy deny disallowed exact URIs with no downstream read; benign allowed calls reach the server.
mappings.remaining: Inheritance and every URI form are not covered by exact-URI scenarios.

mappings.scope: A deliberately noncompliant scripted provider attempts a disallowed call; B/C reject while the unmediated A control executes.
mappings.remaining: Runtime interception does not satisfy the baseline LLM-behavior requirement; semantic effectiveness belongs to #49.

mappings.scope: The proxy emits an observed denial event correlated to an attempted disallowed call.
mappings.remaining: Synthetic fixture logs are not an operational security monitoring or audit-retention system.

mappings.scope: Wrong-owner namespace, changed durable version and old signed session prompt suppress later calls.
mappings.remaining: Distributed state, every checkpoint lifecycle and exactly-once effects remain outside this fixture scope.

mappings.scope: Host-owned no-training restrictions conflict with authenticated recipient capabilities at inference and dispatch.
mappings.remaining: The remaining vocabulary, implications, obligations and policy origins require separate evidence.

mappings.scope: Actual provider, host, proxy and server boundaries are observed; a bypass is graded as a successful control, not protection.
mappings.remaining: No universal egress coverage, topology downgrade proof, layer independence or production conformance is claimed.

mappings.scope: The governed server evaluates its own output covenant and suppresses the actual synthetic data before any provider receipt.
mappings.remaining: This output-denial case does not implement the optional redaction/masking/summarization forms.

mappings.scope: The unmediated control executes forbidden effects when the scripted provider ignores declarations.
mappings.remaining: A scripted provider cannot measure real semantic compliance; no deterministic-profile enforcement or regulated-data claim is made.

mappings.scope: Extra model-generated authority fields fail the host tool schema and cannot replace launcher-owned identity.
mappings.remaining: Transport metadata and these finite markers are not exhaustive provenance or engine-isolation proofs.
